leads.summary: Smooth is an AI browser agent that automates web tasks with high reliability while being 5x faster and 7x cheaper than alternatives.
leads.hook: Site benchmarks show 92% on WebVoyager leaderboard, 5x faster than Browser-Use, uses small efficient models
leads.angle_reason: Smooth needs to understand and reason about complex web interactions, similar to how Canopy performs multi-language code analysis across systems.

leads.summary: Moonset Health is an AI scribe for hospice and home health providers that transcribes patient visits and automates documentation compliance.
leads.hook: Site reports 50,000+ hours saved for clinicians and 87% average reduction in IDG prep time through automated transcription.
leads.angle_reason: Both handle sensitive health data, use LLM APIs for analysis and extraction, require secure backend systems with strict access controls.

leads.summary: Hestus is an AI-powered CAD tool that speeds up hardware design by automating repetitive constraints and providing intelligent suggestions.
leads.hook: Specific metrics: 2.5x faster design cycles and 4x fewer clicks through AI-suggested constraints and geometry mirroring.
leads.angle_reason: Hestus must understand CAD patterns and suggest improvements, similar to Canopy's analysis of code patterns and architecture.

leads.summary: Juno is an AI health assistant for people with chronic illness that tracks symptoms, identifies patterns, and prepares summaries for doctor appointments.
leads.hook: Supports 8,869+ conditions, launched October 2025, now 300,000+ patients globally with voice and text input plus emotional support.
leads.angle_reason: Both are patient-facing health tech using LLM APIs for personalized advice, require secure backends with user data isolation and HIPAA-like compliance.

leads.summary: Beglaubigt.de is a legal back-office platform automating company formation, notarization, and compliance for European founders.
leads.hook: Reduces GmbH incorporation from 6-8 weeks to 3 days through fully automated APIs with integration partners like Qonto and Sevdesk.
leads.angle_reason: Legal/administrative services platform does not align with candidate's dev-tools or health-tech expertise.
red_flags: team of 15 may indicate larger enterprise, not aligned with startup preference

leads.summary: Waydev is an engineering intelligence platform that measures developer productivity and ROI using DORA, SPACE, and DX metrics.
leads.hook: G2 Market Leader in Software Engineering Intelligence (Summer & Spring 2026); now measuring AI Agent and Builder productivity patterns.
leads.angle_reason: Both analyze complex engineering systems—Canopy for code architecture, Waydev for team productivity patterns across the SDLC.

leads.summary: BetterBasket is an AI platform helping grocery retailers optimize pricing, promotions, and assortment using real-time data and AI agents.
leads.hook: Specific ROI metrics: 6% margin uplift on optimized SKUs, 14% more revenue on promo campaigns, covers 2.3M+ SKUs in catalog.
leads.angle_reason: Like Canopy's multi-data-source analysis, BetterBasket integrates retailer systems and suggests improvements across pricing, promotions, and inventory.

leads.summary: Karumi is an AI agent that joins video calls to deliver personalized product demos and enable self-guided product exploration 24/7.
leads.hook: 102,023+ product demos delivered with 38% conversion rate; prospects spend up to 40 minutes with agent before sales call.
leads.angle_reason: Both use LLM APIs to provide conversational, personalized assistance to end users; requires managing state and integrating with external systems.

leads.summary: Macadamia builds AI agents that automate engineering and back-office processes for mechanical engineering, manufacturing, and construction firms.
leads.hook: Specific AI agents: CAD Technician, Safety Engineer, QA Inspector, Cost Estimator with integration to AutoCAD, P&IDs, and equipment specs.
leads.angle_reason: Macadamia must understand complex engineering systems and processes like Canopy understands code architecture.

leads.summary: Allus AI develops vision foundation models for manufacturing that help factories see, understand, and optimize production in real time.
leads.hook: Three-layer system: AllusONE (core vision model), AllusFlow (video-to-steps timing), AllusEdge (edge hardware deployment); SOC2 Type II certified.
leads.angle_reason: AllusFlow and AllusEdge turn raw video into structured, actionable output in production, similar to MedVault's pipeline for turning raw model output into a fixed, reliable JSON schema.
